script_text:
Stop, Aries—your fire-sign ruler is turning back, and your next choice matters. With Aries on the 1st House cusp, Mars is stationing retrograde at 17° Scorpio in your 9th House of expansion. The Moon in your 7th House of partnerships forms a supportive sextile to Mars, easing honest conversation and shared plans.

If you’re single, this favors a confident, independent partner who initiates honestly and values adventure. If you’re attached, ask your partner what they need instead of retreating into work.

In your 10th House of career, review a proposal involving publishing, teaching, foreign clients, or travel. A polished conversation can now secure a promotion, new contract, or international client; check the fine print before you commit.

Avoid impulsively booking nonrefundable travel; an unexpected introduction may become the more valuable detour.

Subscribe so you don’t miss tomorrow’s Aries reading.
